const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /tmp/repair_w27_fix2_verify.py
+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib
+import json
+import sys
+
+ROOT = Path("/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation")
+TASK = ROOT / ".ai/task/repair-w27-20260924"
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
+
+from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
+from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
+from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
+
+WRATH = "295b84f066bb5e2610c84354d9f94de40a32ef9ded864d97373d29cbf3df47c5"
+MUCUS = "fdff442a1e55fecae18f6dd9bb4761bb6c0572059c4f4a1706ef5d06fa3ff2d2"
+
+workset = json.loads((TASK / "WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
+allowed = {
+    (item["normalized_path"], item["section"], item["source"], item["source_tag"]): item
+    for item in workset
+}
+loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
+changed = []
+selected = {}
+record_counts = {}
+
+for filename in ("mod-tome.lua", "tome-ashes-urhrok.lua"):
+    before = loader.load_path(TASK / "baseline" / filename, logical_path=filename).records
+    after = loader.load_path(ROOT / filename, logical_path=filename).records
+    assert len(before) == len(after)
+    record_counts[filename] = len(after)
+    for old, new in zip(before, after):
+        old_without_line = {k: v for k, v in old.items() if k != "line"}
+        new_without_line = {k: v for k, v in new.items() if k != "line"}
+        if old_without_line == new_without_line:
+            continue
+        key = (filename, old["section"], old["source"], old["source_tag"])
+        assert key in allowed, key
+        assert {k: v for k, v in old_without_line.items() if k != "target"} == {
+            k: v for k, v in new_without_line.items() if k != "target"
+        }
+        revision = allowed[key]["entry_revision_identity"]
+        changed.append(revision)
+        if revision in (WRATH, MUCUS):
+            selected[revision] = {
+                "file": filename,
+                "source_lf": new["source"].count("\n"),
+                "source_tab": new["source"].count("\t"),
+                "target_lf": new["target"].count("\n"),
+                "target_tab": new["target"].count("\t"),
+                "target": new["target"],
+            }
+
+assert len(changed) == 28
+assert set(changed) == {item["entry_revision_identity"] for item in workset}
+assert set(selected) == {WRATH, MUCUS}
+assert selected[WRATH]["source_lf"] == selected[WRATH]["target_lf"] == 9
+assert selected[WRATH]["source_tab"] == selected[WRATH]["target_tab"] == 18
+wrath_lines = selected[WRATH]["target"].splitlines()
+assert len(wrath_lines) == 10
+assert all(line.startswith("\t\t") for line in wrath_lines[1:])
+assert all(line.startswith("\t\t-") for line in wrath_lines[3:])
+assert selected[MUCUS]["source_lf"] == selected[MUCUS]["target_lf"] == 5
+assert selected[MUCUS]["source_tab"] == selected[MUCUS]["target_tab"] == 10
+
+anchors = json.loads((TASK / "SOURCE-ANCHORS.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+ashes_root = Path(anchors["ashes_checkout"])
+anchor_checks = {}
+for query in anchors["queries"]:
+    if query["revision_key"] not in (WRATH, MUCUS):
+        continue
+    if query["component"] == "ashes-urhrok":
+        source_path = ashes_root / query["public_source_path"]
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(source_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+        assert digest == query["file_sha256"]
+        anchor_checks[query["revision_key"]] = {
+            "source_identity": query["source_identity"],
+            "file_sha256": digest,
+            "matching_lines": query["matching_lines"],
+        }
+    else:
+        anchor_checks[query["revision_key"]] = {
+            "source_identity": query["source_identity"],
+            "file_sha256": query["file_sha256"],
+            "matching_lines": query["matching_lines"],
+        }
+
+print(json.dumps({
+    "verified": True,
+    "runtime": "manifest LuaJIT via LocaleLoader",
+    "record_counts": record_counts,
+    "changed_count": len(changed),
+    "changed_revisions_exact": sorted(changed),
+    "selected_counts": {
+        revision: {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k != "target"}
+        for revision, row in selected.items()
+    },
+    "source_anchor_checks": anchor_checks,
+}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
